logic.entry: On each completed UTC signal dayj, VWMA_L=sum(C_i*V_i)/sum(V_i),i=j-L+1..j,includingj;C is last closed minute close,V is sum of1440closed-minute base-asset volumes. Exact Fraction from daily Float64decimal strings,canonical ratioSHA,Decimal60display only. NeedLclosed days,no padding. If window volume iszero,preserve actual position without a trade. When flat,enter iff close>VWMA*(1+entry_hurdle_fraction),strict.
logic.exit: When actually long,exit iff C_j<VWMA_L*(1-b),strict;equality/deadband preserves position. No short,leverage,add-on,transfer,cash interest or same-decision reentry;costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)
parameters.arithmetic: Exact Fraction from daily Float64decimal strings;Decimal60display,accounting Decimal28
